summary.text: George Borrello is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 57 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Borrello took office on November 26, 2019, and is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: George Borrello assumed office in the State Senate on November 26, 2019, representing District 57.
In the 2025-2026 session he is ranking member of the Agriculture and Banks committees and is also assigned to the Commerce, Economic Development and Small Business Committee.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Borrello faces Victoria Guite-Williams (D / Working Families Party).
